review:
A three-reel, one-row dungeon crawler. Any non-X symbol triggers a respin, and three in one spin awards five more. Monsters wait in a queue, each with a number of lives, and you fight them one at a time.

Beaten monsters drop chests that always pay and can add features like 2x to 5x multipliers. More mini-game than slot. Extreme volatility, 11,916x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
